description: Search federal awards by keyword, recipient, agency, award type, NAICS code, assistance listing (CFDA) number, PSC, DEF code, location, or date range. Returns ranked award summaries including recipient names, amounts, awarding agencies, and generated award IDs for use with usaspending_get_award; loan rows carry loan value, subsidy cost, and issue date in place of award amount and dates. Award types: A/B/C/D = contracts, IDV_A–IDV_E = IDVs, 02/03/04/05/F001/F002 = grants, 06/10/F006/F007 = direct payments, 07/08/F003/F004 = loans, 09/11/-1/F005/F008/F009/F010 = other assistance. Dates must be ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD). Earliest data: 2007-10-01 via search API. DoD contracts have a 90-day publication lag.

agency_name.description: Awarding top-tier or sub-tier agency name — use the matched name from usaspending_autocomplete_filters type=awarding_agency; use toptier_name to select the whole parent department. A sub-tier name shared by several parents matches under all parents.

assistance_listings.description: Filter by Assistance Listing (CFDA) program numbers, e.g. ["15.507"]: two digits, a dot, then three digits or capital letters (11.67A). Matches an award when any of its listings equals one of these exactly; several values match any of them. A matching award's primary listing can differ from the one requested, and amounts cover the whole award, not that listing's share. Only assistance awards (grants, direct payments, loans, other assistance) carry listings, so a call whose award types are all contracts or IDVs — including a contract default — is rejected as assistance_listings_type_mismatch. Use usaspending_autocomplete_filters type=cfda to look up numbers.

award_type_codes.description: Filter by award type codes. All codes must belong to a single group: A/B/C/D (contracts), IDV_A/IDV_B/IDV_B_A/IDV_B_B/IDV_B_C/IDV_C/IDV_D/IDV_E (IDVs), 02/03/04/05/F001/F002 (grants), 06/10/F006/F007 (direct payments), 07/08/F003/F004 (loans), 09/11/-1/F005/F008/F009/F010 (other assistance). Defaults to contracts. Mixing groups causes a 422 error. The group decides which sort values apply.

def_codes.description: Filter by Disaster Emergency Fund Codes (DEF), e.g. ["Z"], or ["L", "M", "N", "O", "P"] for COVID-19: 1–3 letters or digits, sent uppercased — the codes usaspending_disaster_spending takes and usaspending_get_agency lists. Matches awards of any type funded under any of these codes. Amounts cover the whole matching award, not the share funded by the code, and DEF-filtered totals can be negative. An unknown code is rejected with the list of codes USAspending accepts.

items.description: Disaster Emergency Fund Code, e.g. Z or L

filters.description: Optional analytics-style filter object mirroring the shape the spending analytics tools accept, for reusing one filter set across tools. When both this object and the equivalent top-level flat filters are given, this object wins per-field. recipient_id is rejected — this endpoint silently ignores it; filter by recipient via recipient_name.

agency_name.description: Awarding top-tier or sub-tier agency name — use the matched name from usaspending_autocomplete_filters type=awarding_agency; use toptier_name to select the whole parent department. A sub-tier name shared by several parents matches under all parents.

assistance_listings.description: Filter by Assistance Listing (CFDA) program numbers, e.g. ["15.507"]: two digits, a dot, then three digits or capital letters (11.67A). Matches an award when any of its listings equals one of these exactly; several values match any of them. A matching award's primary listing can differ from the one requested, and amounts cover the whole award, not that listing's share. Only assistance awards (grants, direct payments, loans, other assistance) carry listings, so a call whose award types are all contracts or IDVs — including a contract default — is rejected as assistance_listings_type_mismatch. Use usaspending_autocomplete_filters type=cfda to look up numbers.

award_type_codes.description: Award type codes; all must belong to one group (A/B/C/D contracts, IDV_A–IDV_E IDVs, 02/03/04/05/F001/F002 grants, 06/10/F006/F007 direct payments, 07/08/F003/F004 loans, 09/11/-1/F005/F008/F009/F010 other assistance). When non-empty, overrides the top-level award_type_codes and decides which sort values apply; an empty array falls back to the top-level value.

def_codes.description: Filter by Disaster Emergency Fund Codes (DEF), e.g. ["Z"], or ["L", "M", "N", "O", "P"] for COVID-19: 1–3 letters or digits, sent uppercased — the codes usaspending_disaster_spending takes and usaspending_get_agency lists. Matches awards of any type funded under any of these codes. Amounts cover the whole matching award, not the share funded by the code, and DEF-filtered totals can be negative. An unknown code is rejected with the list of codes USAspending accepts.

items.description: Disaster Emergency Fund Code, e.g. Z or L

keywords.description: Full-text search terms across award descriptions, recipient names, and places

naics_codes.description: NAICS industry codes to require, e.g., ["541512"]

psc_codes.description: Filter by Product and Service Codes (PSC), e.g. ["Y1NE"]: 1–4 letters or digits, sent uppercased. A shorter code covers every code under it ("Y1" covers "Y1NE"); several values match any of them. Only contracts and IDVs carry a PSC, so a call whose award types are all assistance types is rejected as psc_codes_type_mismatch, and pairing psc_codes with assistance_listings matches nothing, since no award carries both. Use usaspending_autocomplete_filters type=psc to look up codes.

items.description: Product and Service Code or prefix, e.g. Y1NE or Y1

recipient_name.description: Recipient name search (partial match); maps to recipient_search_text. Use instead of recipient_id, which this endpoint ignores.

anyOf.description: Date as YYYY-MM-DD; month and day may be unpadded

time_period_end.description: End date (YYYY-MM-DD). Given alone, the range starts at 2007-10-01, the earliest searchable date.

anyOf.description: Date as YYYY-MM-DD; month and day may be unpadded

time_period_start.description: Start date (YYYY-MM-DD); earliest valid 2007-10-01. Given alone, the range runs through today (UTC).

keyword.description: Full-text search across award descriptions, recipient names, and place names

last_record_sort_value.description: Keyset-pagination cursor: the last_record_sort_value from a prior response page_metadata. Provide together with last_record_unique_id to fetch the next page past the 50,000-result page-number cap. The upstream stops emitting the pair once page × limit reaches 10,000, so take it from a page below that offset. When both cursor fields are supplied, page is ignored.

last_record_unique_id.description: Keyset-pagination cursor: the last_record_unique_id from a prior response page_metadata. Provide together with last_record_sort_value.

location_filter.description: Filter by place of performance. Takes codes, not place names — use a geocoding server to resolve names to codes first. Blank fields are ignored, and an all-blank object is no location filter. The location sent is echoed as applied_location.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code (e.g., USA); USA when omitted. A US territory code — PRI, GUM, VIR, ASM, MNP — is sent as USA with the territory as state.

county.description: US county FIPS code: 3 digits with state (049 with state NM), or the 5-digit state + county code (35049, Santa Fe County, NM), whose first two digits set the state — the form usaspending_spending_by_geography county rows carry as shape_code.

state.description: Under USA (the default): a US state, DC, territory, freely associated state, or armed-forces code as a 2-letter postal code (NM, PR, FM, AE) or 2-digit FIPS code (35). Under another country: that country's own 2-letter subdivision code (ON with CAN).

naics_codes.description: Filter by NAICS industry codes (e.g., ["541512"]). Use usaspending_autocomplete_filters type=naics to look up codes.

page.description: Page number (1-based). Page-number pagination caps at a 50,000-result offset (page × limit), but the keyset cursor below is only returned while the offset stays under 10,000 — capture the cursor pair before paging past that, or the only way forward is page numbers.

psc_codes.description: Filter by Product and Service Codes (PSC), e.g. ["Y1NE"]: 1–4 letters or digits, sent uppercased. A shorter code covers every code under it ("Y1" covers "Y1NE"); several values match any of them. Only contracts and IDVs carry a PSC, so a call whose award types are all assistance types is rejected as psc_codes_type_mismatch, and pairing psc_codes with assistance_listings matches nothing, since no award carries both. Use usaspending_autocomplete_filters type=psc to look up codes.

items.description: Product and Service Code or prefix, e.g. Y1NE or Y1

recipient_name.description: Filter by recipient name (partial match); maps to this endpoint's recipient_search_text. This endpoint has no recipient_id filter — use usaspending_search_recipients to look up a recipient by name.

sort.description: Sort field for results. Loans (07/08/F003/F004) sort by Loan Value, Subsidy Cost, Issued Date, Recipient Name, or Awarding Agency, defaulting to Loan Value. Every other group sorts by Award Amount, Total Outlays, Start Date, End Date, Recipient Name, or Awarding Agency, defaulting to Award Amount — except IDVs, which have no End Date. A sort the group does not support is rejected before the search runs.

time_period.description: Filter awards by date range (action date). Both blank means no date filter; one blank end is filled and named in the notice.

anyOf.description: Date as YYYY-MM-DD; month and day may be unpadded

end_date.description: End date in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD). Blank ("") leaves the end open, filled with today (UTC).

anyOf.description: Date as YYYY-MM-DD; month and day may be unpadded

start_date.description: Start date in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD); earliest valid: 2007-10-01. Blank ("") leaves the start open, filled with 2007-10-01.

name: usaspending_search_awards

applied_keyword.description: Keyword filter applied to this search

applied_location.description: Place of performance location sent, as normalized (e.g. country=USA, state=NM, county=049)

applied_time_period_end.description: End of the date range sent (YYYY-MM-DD), including a filled-in end

applied_time_period_start.description: Start of the date range sent (YYYY-MM-DD), including a filled-in start

cap.description: Per-page cap (limit) applied to this page, when truncated.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `incomplete_cursor`: Only one of last_record_sort_value and last_record_unique_id was supplied. `api_unavailable`: USAspending.gov API is unreachable or returns an error. `api_timeout`: USAspending.gov did not respond before the request deadline elapsed. `pagination_limit_exceeded`: page multiplied by limit exceeds the endpoint 50,000-result page window and no cursor was supplied. `date_before_earliest`: The resolved start date precedes the 2007-10-01 earliest date this endpoint can search. `date_range_inverted`: Both ends of the date range were supplied and the start date falls after the end date. `unsupported_sort`: The sort value is not one the award type group supports. `assistance_listings_type_mismatch`: assistance_listings was given while the award type codes include contract or IDV codes, or were left at the contract default. `psc_codes_type_mismatch`: psc_codes was given while the award type codes include assistance codes. `invalid_location`: location_filter names an unknown US state, a county without a state or under an armed-forces code, a county or FIPS-number state under a non-USA country, or parts that place it in different states. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

has_next.description: Whether more results may remain — set on a full page even when the upstream flag reports none.

notice.description: How to page on when more results may remain, which date bound was filled in when only the other was supplied, and the applied filters on an empty page. This endpoint supplies no total, so an empty page does not establish zero matches. Absent when none applies.

page_metadata.description: Pagination metadata. This endpoint does not return a total match count; use has_next and the cursor pair to page.

has_next.description: Whether more results may remain — true on a full page even when the upstream flag reports none, since this endpoint under-reports continuation on a final full page and on every page past a 10,000-result offset. A short or empty page marks the end.

last_record_sort_value.description: Keyset-pagination cursor for the next page — pass back as last_record_sort_value to continue past the 50,000-result page limit. Absent once page × limit reaches 10,000, where the upstream stops emitting the pair.

last_record_unique_id.description: Keyset-pagination cursor for the next page — pass back as last_record_unique_id alongside last_record_sort_value. Absent on the same pages that omit last_record_sort_value.

items.description: Award summary with amounts, agencies, and chaining IDs

agency_slug.description: URL-friendly awarding-agency slug (e.g., national-aeronautics-and-space-administration) — pass to usaspending_get_agency as agency_slug. Absent when the agency has no profile page.

award_id.description: Display award ID (piid, fain, or uri) — NOT the chaining ID

generated_internal_id.description: Generated unique award ID — pass to usaspending_get_award to fetch full details

issued_date.description: Date the loan was issued (YYYY-MM-DD; loans only — they carry no start or end date)

loan_value.description: Face value of the loan in USD (loans only — they carry no award_amount)

subsidy_cost.description: Original subsidy cost of the loan in USD — the estimated long-term cost to the government (loans only)

shown.description: Number of awards returned on this page, when truncated.

truncated.description: True when the upstream reports more results beyond this page (continue via page or the cursor). Absent on a full page the upstream marks as last, including every page past a 10,000-result offset where the upstream stops reporting continuation — has_next still says whether to request another.

upstream_messages.description: Notices the USAspending API returned with this response — e.g. a supplied filter it ignored because this endpoint does not support it. Every successful response also carries a standing advisory that search covers 2007-10-01 onward; that advisory is boilerplate, not a verdict on the dates requested. Present whenever the API returns any messages.
